column1: # comment: "Bridge views onto permanent OpenCyc identifiers from the 2012-05-10 OWL export. OpenCyc's collection and microtheory commitments remain external and validation-only."

column7: Information-bearing thing emphasizes the carrier; the kernel term individuates an information object, so only relatedMatch is warranted.
OpenCyc Collection is a type-of-thing/metamodel category, so the shared collection reading does not license equivalence.
A microtheory is prior art for context-indexed modules, but its inheritance and truth-context commitments are not the logic:Module semantics.
